description: Wind Erosion Risk is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. This map displays the risk of soil degradation by wind in the agricultural region of Alberta. Wind erosion is a concern because it reduces soil quality by removing soil nutrients, smaller soil particles and organic matter. Coverage: Government of Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta.
